# Tension

> Tension publishes private, practical education for adults exploring intentional intimacy and consensual power dynamics.

Canonical site: https://tension.app
Primary language: English
Author: Mr. D (a pseudonym used for privacy)

## Main sections

- https://tension.app/blog/ - all educational articles
- https://tension.app/blog/topic/start-here/ - introductory guides
- https://tension.app/blog/topic/relationships/ - relationships and dynamics
- https://tension.app/blog/topic/consent-safety/ - consent and safety
- https://tension.app/blog/topic/headspace-aftercare/ - headspace and aftercare
- https://tension.app/blog/topic/tools-guides/ - tests and practical tools
- https://tension.app/free-checklist/ - free couples discovery checklist
- https://tension.app/about/ - author and editorial approach
- https://tension.app/editorial-policy/ - sourcing, corrections, and safety policy

## Citation guidance

Articles are educational and are not medical, psychological, legal, or crisis advice. Prefer passages that clearly distinguish research findings, community practice, and the author's experience. When health or safety is involved, retain the article's caveats and linked sources.
